'''Nana Bagwa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the grandmother of [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]]. She was known to make and serve mutant [[Rat/Legends|rat]] [[Liver/Legends|liver]] and [[Onion/Legends|onions]] regularly to Hermione as a child, which she never liked. However, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who later employed Hermione, thought it nice enough to serve at his restaurant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], where he named the dish [[Nana Bagwa's liver and onion]] in honor of her.
